#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Move this Flux fleet onto ConfigHub. Written by `cub flux apply`.
# Read it, then run it, one cluster at a time:
#
#   CONFIGHUB_OCI=<gateway host the cluster reaches> CLUSTER=<cluster, as plan names it> \
#   FLUX_CONTEXT=<kubectl context of that cluster> bash handover.sh
#
# Run apply.sh first. Each layer keeps its Kustomization, its name and its
# inventory; only the source changes, so nothing is reinstalled.
#
# Rehearsed end to end on Flux v2.8.6 against ConfigHub v0.6.8: every UID
# survived, including the Pod's, and the rollout revision did not change.
# Your fleet is not that one. Read every step before running it, and start
# with one non-production cluster.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
ctx=${FLUX_CONTEXT:-$(kubectl config current-context 2>/dev/null || true)}
[ -n "$ctx" ] || { echo "no kubectl context: set FLUX_CONTEXT to the cluster to hand over"; exit 1; }
k() { kubectl --context "$ctx" "$@"; }
step() { printf '\n== %s\n' "$*"; }
ns=${FLUX_NAMESPACE:-flux-system}
cluster=${CLUSTER:-}
# The comparison below re-renders from the repository, so it needs it.
REPO_ROOT=${REPO_ROOT:-'<repo>'}
case "$cluster" in dev-1|staging-1|prod-1) ;; *) echo "set CLUSTER=<one of: dev-1, staging-1, prod-1> so the right Target is used"; exit 1 ;; esac

step "0/4 Check before changing anything"
cub auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "cub is not signed in to ConfigHub: run 'cub auth login', or 'cub auth login --private-key=<key>' on a server with no identity provider"; exit 1; }
echo "  every kubectl call below uses context $ctx"
k get namespace "$ns" >/dev/null || { echo "no $ns namespace: is this the right cluster?"; exit 1; }
# flux-system reconciles the Flux controllers themselves. It is the way back
# if anything here goes wrong, so it stays on Git and is never repointed.
echo 'Left alone: gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/dev/flux-system'
echo 'Left alone: gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/prod/flux-system'
echo 'Left alone: gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/staging/flux-system'
# A layer another Kustomization applies from Git (flux-system, in a fleet made
# with flux bootstrap) cannot simply be taken over: that owner re-applies it,
# and when the layer later leaves its Git, the owner deletes it, and the layer's
# pruning deletes everything it runs, unless the root applied it last. Measured
# on Flux v2.8.6. So such a fleet is handed over with that owner suspended, and
# the owner resumes only once its Git no longer defines the layers.
owners=""
owner_of() { k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.kustomize\.toolkit\.fluxcd\.io/name}' 2>/dev/null || true; }
o=$(owner_of 'infrastructure'); case "$o" in ""|confighub-root) ;; *) case " $owners " in *" $o "*) ;; *) owners="$owners $o" ;; esac ;; esac
o=$(owner_of 'apps'); case "$o" in ""|confighub-root) ;; *) case " $owners " in *" $o "*) ;; *) owners="$owners $o" ;; esac ;; esac
o=$(owner_of 'tenants'); case "$o" in ""|confighub-root) ;; *) case " $owners " in *" $o "*) ;; *) owners="$owners $o" ;; esac ;; esac
case "$cluster" in dev-1) o=$(owner_of 'image-automation'); case "$o" in ""|confighub-root) ;; *) case " $owners " in *" $o "*) ;; *) owners="$owners $o" ;; esac ;; esac ;; esac
case "$cluster" in
  dev-1) dir='gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/dev' ;;
  staging-1) dir='gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/staging' ;;
  prod-1) dir='gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/prod' ;;
esac
# The files that define each layer for this cluster: what the commit removes.
layer_files=""
[ "$cluster" != 'dev-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/dev/infrastructure.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'staging-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/staging/infrastructure.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'prod-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/prod/infrastructure.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'dev-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/dev/apps.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'staging-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/staging/apps.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'prod-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/prod/apps.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'dev-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/dev/tenants.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'staging-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/staging/tenants.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'prod-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/prod/tenants.yaml"
[ "$cluster" != 'dev-1' ] || layer_files="$layer_files gitops/flux/expert-fleet/clusters/dev/image-automation.yaml"
owner=""
# A re-run finds the layers already the root's. The owner a first run
# suspended is in its state, and the run carries on from there.
owner_file="handover-state/$cluster.owner"
if [ -z "$owners" ] && [ -f "$owner_file" ]; then owners=$(cat "$owner_file"); echo "  continuing: $owners was suspended by an earlier run"; fi
if [ -n "$owners" ]; then
  set -- $owners
  [ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo "The layers are applied by several Kustomizations:$owners. This handover moves them from one owner at a time." >&2; exit 1; }
  owner=$1
  [ "$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$owner" -o jsonpath='{.spec.sourceRef.kind}')" = GitRepository ] || { echo "Kustomization $owner applies the layers but does not read Git; this handover cannot move them from it." >&2; exit 1; }
  echo "  the layers are applied by Kustomization $owner from Git: it will be suspended while the root takes them over, and resumed once Git no longer defines them"
fi

step "1/4 Prove each layer holds what Git renders today"
# Every layer prunes, so anything a release does not hold is deleted from
# the cluster. This renders from the repository now rather than trusting
# what apply.sh left in render/: Git may have moved since, and a stale
# comparison would pass while the cluster applies something else.
command -v kustomize >/dev/null || { echo "kustomize is not on PATH; this step re-renders with it"; exit 1; }
[ -d "$REPO_ROOT" ] || { echo "REPO_ROOT=$REPO_ROOT is not a directory: point it at the repository checkout"; exit 1; }
echo "  rendering with $(kustomize version)"
if ! git -C "$REPO_ROOT" diff --quiet 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "  note: $REPO_ROOT has uncommitted changes, so this renders something Flux is not applying" >&2
fi
build() {
  has_k() { [ -e "$1/kustomization.yaml" ] || [ -e "$1/kustomization.yml" ] || [ -e "$1/Kustomization" ]; }
  if has_k "$1" || [ ! -d "$1" ]; then kustomize build ${KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS:-} "$1"; return; fi
  # list <dir> <as>: what Flux would list under dir, named as <as>/...
  list() {
    local f
    for f in "$1"/*; do
      [ -e "$f" ] || continue
      if [ -d "$f" ]; then
        if has_k "$f"; then echo "- $2/${f##*/}"; else list "$f" "$2/${f##*/}"; fi
      else
        case "$f" in *.yaml|*.yml) echo "- $2/${f##*/}" ;; esac
      fi
    done
  }
  # kustomize takes a directory resource only by a relative path, so the
  # layer is linked beside the kustomization that lists it.
  local k rc=0
  k=$(mktemp -d)
  ln -s "$(cd "$1" && pwd)" "$k/src" || { rm -rf "$k"; return 1; }
  { echo "resources:"; LC_ALL=C list "$k/src" src; } > "$k/kustomization.yaml"
  kustomize build ${KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS:-} --load-restrictor LoadRestrictionsNone "$k" || rc=$?
  rm -rf "$k"; return $rc
}
# same <space> <unit> <path>
same() {
  local fresh got rc=0
  fresh=$(mktemp); got=$(mktemp)
  build "$REPO_ROOT/$3" > "$fresh" || { rm -f "$fresh" "$got"; return 1; }
  cub unit data --space "$1" "$2" > "$got" || { rm -f "$fresh" "$got"; return 1; }
  if diff -q <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$fresh") <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$got") >/dev/null; then
    echo "  $1 holds what $3 renders today"
  else
    echo "  $1 DIFFERS from what $3 renders today. Swapping its source would prune the difference." >&2
    echo "  Re-run apply.sh to bring ConfigHub up to date, then read the diff before swapping." >&2
    diff -u <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$fresh") <(grep -v '^\s*#' "$got") | head -40 >&2
    rc=1
  fi
  rm -f "$fresh" "$got"; return $rc
}
[ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ] && same 'flux-infrastructure-dev-1' 'infrastructure' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/dev'
[ "$cluster" = 'staging-1' ] && same 'flux-infrastructure-staging-1' 'infrastructure' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/staging'
[ "$cluster" = 'prod-1' ] && same 'flux-infrastructure-prod-1' 'infrastructure' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/infrastructure/prod'
[ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ] && same 'flux-apps-dev-1' 'apps' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/dev'
[ "$cluster" = 'staging-1' ] && same 'flux-apps-staging-1' 'apps' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/staging'
[ "$cluster" = 'prod-1' ] && same 'flux-apps-prod-1' 'apps' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/apps/prod'
[ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ] && same 'flux-tenants-dev-1' 'tenants' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/dev'
[ "$cluster" = 'staging-1' ] && same 'flux-tenants-staging-1' 'tenants' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/staging'
[ "$cluster" = 'prod-1' ] && same 'flux-tenants-prod-1' 'tenants' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/tenants/prod'
[ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ] && same 'flux-image-automation-dev-1' 'image-automation' 'gitops/flux/expert-fleet/image-automation'

# And the question the comparison above cannot reach: does what ConfigHub
# would deliver equal what this layer has actually applied? Flux's own
# status.inventory is the record. Every layer here prunes, so an object it
# applied that the release does not hold is deleted the moment the source
# is swapped, whether or not it was ever in Git.
if [ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ]; then
  space_infrastructure='flux-infrastructure-dev-1'
  digest_infrastructure=$(cub release get --space 'flux-infrastructure-dev-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'infrastructure' --space 'flux-infrastructure-dev-1' --unit 'infrastructure' --release "$digest_infrastructure"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'staging-1' ]; then
  space_infrastructure='flux-infrastructure-staging-1'
  digest_infrastructure=$(cub release get --space 'flux-infrastructure-staging-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'infrastructure' --space 'flux-infrastructure-staging-1' --unit 'infrastructure' --release "$digest_infrastructure"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'prod-1' ]; then
  space_infrastructure='flux-infrastructure-prod-1'
  digest_infrastructure=$(cub release get --space 'flux-infrastructure-prod-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'infrastructure' --space 'flux-infrastructure-prod-1' --unit 'infrastructure' --release "$digest_infrastructure"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ]; then
  space_apps='flux-apps-dev-1'
  digest_apps=$(cub release get --space 'flux-apps-dev-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'apps' --space 'flux-apps-dev-1' --unit 'apps' --release "$digest_apps"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'staging-1' ]; then
  space_apps='flux-apps-staging-1'
  digest_apps=$(cub release get --space 'flux-apps-staging-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'apps' --space 'flux-apps-staging-1' --unit 'apps' --release "$digest_apps"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'prod-1' ]; then
  space_apps='flux-apps-prod-1'
  digest_apps=$(cub release get --space 'flux-apps-prod-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'apps' --space 'flux-apps-prod-1' --unit 'apps' --release "$digest_apps"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ]; then
  space_tenants='flux-tenants-dev-1'
  digest_tenants=$(cub release get --space 'flux-tenants-dev-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'tenants' --space 'flux-tenants-dev-1' --unit 'tenants' --release "$digest_tenants"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'staging-1' ]; then
  space_tenants='flux-tenants-staging-1'
  digest_tenants=$(cub release get --space 'flux-tenants-staging-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'tenants' --space 'flux-tenants-staging-1' --unit 'tenants' --release "$digest_tenants"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'prod-1' ]; then
  space_tenants='flux-tenants-prod-1'
  digest_tenants=$(cub release get --space 'flux-tenants-prod-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'tenants' --space 'flux-tenants-prod-1' --unit 'tenants' --release "$digest_tenants"
fi
if [ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ]; then
  space_image_automation='flux-image-automation-dev-1'
  digest_image_automation=$(cub release get --space 'flux-image-automation-dev-1' --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  cub flux check --kube-context "$ctx" --namespace 'flux-system' --kustomization 'image-automation' --space 'flux-image-automation-dev-1' --unit 'image-automation' --release "$digest_image_automation"
fi

# What no controller claims in this fleet, as a cross-check. cub-scout
# infers ownership where the inventory is Flux's own record, so this is
# not a gate: it finds what was applied by hand and would be left behind.
# It reads kubectl's current context and takes no flag for another, so it
# gets a kubeconfig holding only this cluster. It looks where the layers
# put things, not at Flux's own controllers or the cluster's system.
scout() {
  local kc; kc=$(mktemp)
  if ! kubectl config view --minify --flatten --context "$ctx" > "$kc" 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f "$kc"; echo "  no kubectl context $ctx; skipping the cross-check" >&2; return 0
  fi
  KUBECONFIG="$kc" cub scout map list -q "$1" || true
  rm -f "$kc"
}
if cub scout --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ "$cluster" = 'dev-1' ]; then
    scout 'owner=Native AND namespace!=flux-system AND namespace!=kube-system AND namespace!=kube-public AND namespace!=kube-node-lease AND name!=kube-root-ca.crt'
  fi
  if [ "$cluster" = 'staging-1' ]; then
    scout 'owner=Native AND namespace!=flux-system AND namespace!=kube-system AND namespace!=kube-public AND namespace!=kube-node-lease AND name!=kube-root-ca.crt'
  fi
  if [ "$cluster" = 'prod-1' ]; then
    scout 'owner=Native AND namespace!=flux-system AND namespace!=kube-system AND namespace!=kube-public AND namespace!=kube-node-lease AND name!=kube-root-ca.crt'
  fi
else
  echo "  cub-scout is not installed; skipping the unclaimed-resource cross-check"
fi

step "2/4 Add the gateway to flux-system: the credential and the root"
# These cannot come from ConfigHub: a Kustomization cannot read a source that
# does not exist yet. They go into the bootstrap directory, which is the one
# part of this fleet that stays on Git; every layer after them comes from the
# cluster's layers Space in ConfigHub.
addr=${CONFIGHUB_OCI:-}
# Every use below writes the scheme itself, so take it off if it was given.
addr=${addr#oci://}
if [ -z "$addr" ]; then
  echo "Set CONFIGHUB_OCI to the gateway host this cluster reaches; oci://<host> is taken too."
  echo "  ConfigHub cloud:  oci.hub.confighub.com"
  echo "  self-hosted:      the host and port of the confighub-oci-server service,"
  echo "                    as reachable FROM this cluster, not from your laptop;"
  echo "                    set CONFIGHUB_OCI_PLAIN_HTTP=1 if it serves plain HTTP."
  echo "Then: CONFIGHUB_OCI=<host> CLUSTER=$cluster bash handover.sh"; exit 1
fi
# The ID and secret go from cub into the Secret through command substitution
# and are never written to disk. --dry-run | apply keeps this re-runnable.
k create secret docker-registry confighub-flux-targets --namespace "$ns" \
  --docker-server="$addr" \
  --docker-username="$(cub worker get --space flux-targets server-worker -o jq=.BridgeWorker.BridgeWorkerID | tr -d '\"\n')" \
  --docker-password="$(cub worker get --space flux-targets server-worker --include-secret -o jq=.BridgeWorker.Secret | tr -d '\"\n')" \
  --dry-run=client -o yaml | k apply -f -

# The root: one source and one Kustomization, reading this cluster's layers
# Space, which apply.sh filled and released. It is all this cluster needs
# from outside ConfigHub, so it goes into the bootstrap directory with the
# credential; every layer after it comes from ConfigHub.
mkdir -p "bootstrap/$cluster"
insecure=false; [ -z "${CONFIGHUB_OCI_PLAIN_HTTP:-}" ] || insecure=true
layers_space='flux-'"$cluster"'-layers'
layers_digest=$(cub release get --space "$layers_space" --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"') || true
[ -n "$layers_digest" ] || { echo "$layers_space has no published release: run apply.sh with CONFIGHUB_OCI set first"; exit 1; }
echo "  $layers_space is at $layers_digest"
layers_still_current() { local now; now=$(cub release get --space "$layers_space" --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"'); [ "$now" = "$layers_digest" ] || { echo "  $layers_space was republished since it was read ($layers_digest, now $now); run again to check what is published now" >&2; return 1; }; }
root_applied_checked() { local a; a=$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization confighub-root -o jsonpath='{.status.lastAppliedRevision}'); [ "${a##*@}" = "$layers_digest" ] || { echo "  the root applied $a, not the checked $layers_digest" >&2; return 1; }; }
cat <<'YAML' | sed -e "s|__CONFIGHUB_OCI__|$addr|" -e "s|__CONFIGHUB_OCI_INSECURE__|$insecure|" -e "s|__FLUX_NAMESPACE__|$ns|" -e "s|__CLUSTER__|$cluster|" > "bootstrap/$cluster/confighub-root.yaml"
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: OCIRepository
metadata:
  name: confighub-root
  namespace: __FLUX_NAMESPACE__
  labels:
    confighub.com/cluster: "__CLUSTER__"
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: oci://__CONFIGHUB_OCI__/space/flux-__CLUSTER__-layers
  ref:
    tag: latest
  secretRef:
    name: confighub-flux-targets
  insecure: __CONFIGHUB_OCI_INSECURE__
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: confighub-root
  namespace: __FLUX_NAMESPACE__
  labels:
    confighub.com/cluster: "__CLUSTER__"
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: OCIRepository
    name: confighub-root
YAML
echo "Commit bootstrap/$cluster/ into this cluster's flux-system path so the root survives a reconcile."

step "3/4 Hand the layers to the root, which reads them from ConfigHub"
# Each layer keeps its name, so Flux keeps the inventory of what it applied,
# and nothing is recreated. The root applies the layer's own Kustomization
# from ConfigHub, which differs from the one on the cluster only in its
# sourceRef and path, and so takes it over: that is the whole move.
#
# Each layer's sourceRef and path are recorded first. If anything below stops
# the script, the way back is printed; nothing is rolled back automatically.
state="handover-state/$cluster.txt"; log="handover-state/$cluster.log"
mkdir -p handover-state; touch "$state"
log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" >> "$log"; }
moved=""; current=""; finished=0; incomplete=""; held=""; suspended_owner=""
# record <layer>: name|kind|source|source namespace|path, as the cluster had it
record() {
  grep -q "^$1|" "$state" && return 0
  local was
  was=$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}{"|"}{.spec.sourceRef.kind}{"|"}{.spec.sourceRef.name}{"|"}{.spec.sourceRef.namespace}{"|"}{.spec.path}')
  case "$was" in
    *"|OCIRepository|"*) echo "  $1 already reads an OCIRepository, and no original was recorded for it here" >&2 ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' "$was" >> "$state"; log "recorded $was" ;;
  esac
}
layer_sources() {
  local name kind src srcns path
  echo "  # last, once each layer reads Git again: the OCIRepositories the root applied, which nothing reads now"
  while IFS='|' read -r name kind src srcns path; do
    case " $moved " in *" $name "*) ;; *) [ "${1:-}" = all ] || continue ;; esac
    [ "$kind" = OCIRepository ] || echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' delete ocirepository $name"
  done < "$state"
}
# way_back [all]: the commands that put the layers back on Git, for the ones
# this run moved, or with "all" for every layer recorded for this cluster.
way_back() {
  local name kind src srcns path ref
  echo "  # first, so that removing the root cannot delete the layers:"
  echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch kustomization confighub-root --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"suspend\":true,\"prune\":false}}'"
  while IFS='|' read -r name kind src srcns path; do
    case " $moved " in *" $name "*) ;; *) [ "${1:-}" = all ] || continue ;; esac
    ref="\"kind\":\"$kind\",\"name\":\"$src\""
    [ -z "$srcns" ] || ref="$ref,\"namespace\":\"$srcns\""
    echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch kustomization $name --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"sourceRef\":{$ref},\"path\":\"$path\"}}'"
  done < "$state"
  echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' delete kustomization confighub-root"
  echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' delete ocirepository confighub-root"
  layer_sources "${1:-}"
  [ -z "$suspended_owner" ] || echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch kustomization $suspended_owner --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"suspend\":false}}'   # its Git still defines the layers"
}
stopped() {
  local rc=$?
  [ "$finished" = 1 ] && return
  echo >&2
  if [ -z "$moved" ]; then
    echo "Stopped (exit $rc) before the root was applied: no layer's source was changed." >&2
    [ -z "$suspended_owner" ] || echo "  $suspended_owner was suspended; resume it: kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch kustomization $suspended_owner --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"suspend\":false}}'" >&2
    return
  fi
  log "stopped at ${current:-?}, exit $rc"
  echo "HANDOVER STOPPED at ${current:-?} (exit $rc), on context $ctx." >&2
  echo "The root is applied, so these layers read ConfigHub, or are moving to:$moved" >&2
  echo "Nothing is rolled back automatically. To put them back on Git, in this order:" >&2
  way_back >&2
  echo "Each layer's original is in $state; what happened is in $log." >&2
}
trap stopped EXIT
# still_current <layer>: the release checked in step 1 is still the newest.
still_current() {
  local dv sv want now
  dv="digest_$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr -- '-./' '___')"; want=${!dv:-}
  sv="space_$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr -- '-./' '___')"
  [ -n "$want" ] || { echo "  $1: no checked release digest was recorded for it" >&2; return 1; }
  now=$(cub release get --space "${!sv}" --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ManifestDigest | tr -d '"')
  [ "$now" = "$want" ] || { echo "  $1: checked release $want, but ${!sv} now publishes $now; re-run to check that one" >&2; return 1; }
}
# arrived <layer>: the root has taken it over, it is Ready, and it applied
# the release that was checked.
arrived() {
  current=$1
  local dv want applied
  dv="digest_$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr -- '-./' '___')"; want=${!dv:-}
  k -n "$ns" wait --for=jsonpath='{.spec.sourceRef.kind}'=OCIRepository "kustomization/$1" --timeout=3m >/dev/null
  if ! k -n "$ns" wait --for=condition=Ready "kustomization/$1" --timeout=5m; then
    log "NOT Ready $1: $(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$1" -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].message}' 2>&1 || true)"
    return 1
  fi
  applied=$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$1" -o jsonpath='{.status.lastAppliedRevision}')
  if [ "${applied##*@}" != "$want" ]; then
    log "$1 applied $applied, not the checked $want"
    echo "  $1: Flux applied $applied, but $want was checked: a newer release went out unchecked" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  log "Ready $1 at $applied, from the root"
}
# committed: the revision the owner reads no longer defines this cluster's
# layers, and does define the root.
committed() {
  local src srcns rev sha f
  src=$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$owner" -o jsonpath='{.spec.sourceRef.name}')
  srcns=$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$owner" -o jsonpath='{.spec.sourceRef.namespace}')
  rev=$(k -n "${srcns:-$ns}" get gitrepository "$src" -o jsonpath='{.status.artifact.revision}')
  sha=${rev##*:}
  git -C "$REPO_ROOT" cat-file -e "$sha^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || { why="$owner reads $rev, which $REPO_ROOT does not have: pull it there"; return 1; }
  for f in $layer_files; do
    if git -C "$REPO_ROOT" cat-file -e "$sha:$f" 2>/dev/null; then why="$rev still has $f"; return 1; fi
  done
  git -C "$REPO_ROOT" grep -q "name: confighub-root" "$sha" -- "$dir" || { why="$rev does not define the root under $dir"; return 1; }
  seen_rev=$rev
}
bootstrapped_finish() {
  local l i why="" seen_rev=""
  for l in $moved; do
    [ "$(owner_of "$l")" = confighub-root ] || { echo "  $l is not owned by the root; $owner stays suspended" >&2; return 1; }
  done
  if ! committed; then
    k -n "$ns" annotate --overwrite "gitrepository/$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$owner" -o jsonpath='{.spec.sourceRef.name}')" "reconcile.fluxcd.io/requestedAt=$(date +%s)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    for i in $(seq 1 12); do committed && break; sleep 5; done
  fi
  if [ -z "$seen_rev" ]; then
    log "paused: $why"
    echo
    echo "PAUSED: every layer is the root's now, and $owner is suspended. ($why)"
    echo "Make one commit in the repository $owner reads, and push it:"
    for l in $layer_files; do echo "  git rm $l"; done
    echo "  cp $PWD/bootstrap/$cluster/confighub-root.yaml $dir/confighub-root.yaml && git add $dir/confighub-root.yaml"
    echo "  git commit -m 'Layers of $cluster come from ConfigHub' && git push      # in $REPO_ROOT"
    echo "Then run this script again. It resumes $owner only once that commit is what $owner reads."
    echo "Do NOT resume $owner by hand before then: it would re-apply the layers from Git, and then delete them, and everything they run, when the commit lands."
    echo "To go back instead, in this order:"
    way_back
    finished=1
    exit 2
  fi
  log "$owner reads $seen_rev: the layers are gone from its Git and the root is in it"
  k -n "$ns" patch kustomization "$owner" --type merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":false}}' >/dev/null
  k -n "$ns" annotate --overwrite "kustomization/$owner" "reconcile.fluxcd.io/requestedAt=$(date +%s)" >/dev/null
  for i in $(seq 1 36); do [ "$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$owner" -o jsonpath='{.status.lastAppliedRevision}')" = "$seen_rev" ] && break; sleep 5; done
  suspended_owner=""
  mv "$owner_file" "$owner_file.resumed"
  log "resumed $owner at $seen_rev"
  for l in $moved; do
    k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$l" >/dev/null || { echo "  $l is gone after $owner resumed" >&2; return 1; }
    [ "$(owner_of "$l")" = confighub-root ] || { echo "  $l is owned by $(owner_of "$l") after $owner resumed" >&2; return 1; }
  done
  [ "$(owner_of confighub-root)" = "$owner" ] && log "the root is now $owner's, from Git" || echo "  note: the root is not yet in $owner's inventory"
  echo "  $owner resumed at $seen_rev; every layer is still the root's"
}
record 'infrastructure'
record 'apps'
record 'tenants'
case "$cluster" in dev-1) record 'image-automation' ;; esac
still_current 'infrastructure'
still_current 'apps'
still_current 'tenants'
case "$cluster" in dev-1) still_current 'image-automation' ;; esac
if [ -n "$owner" ]; then
  if [ "$(k -n "$ns" get kustomization "$owner" -o jsonpath='{.spec.suspend}')" != true ]; then
    k -n "$ns" patch kustomization "$owner" --type merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}' >/dev/null
    log "suspended $owner"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$owner" > "$owner_file"
  suspended_owner=$owner
fi
layers_still_current
current=confighub-root
k apply -f "bootstrap/$cluster/confighub-root.yaml"
moved="$moved infrastructure"
moved="$moved apps"
moved="$moved tenants"
case "$cluster" in dev-1) moved="$moved image-automation" ;; esac
log "applied the root; it reads $layers_space"
k -n "$ns" wait --for=condition=Ready "kustomization/confighub-root" --timeout=5m
root_applied_checked
arrived 'infrastructure'
arrived 'apps'
arrived 'tenants'
case "$cluster" in dev-1) arrived 'image-automation' ;; esac
current=""
if [ -n "$owner" ]; then
  bootstrapped_finish
fi

step "4/4 What is left, and what it means"
# A patch is not a suspension until the cluster says so: read it back. And
# an object a Kustomization applies from Git is that Kustomization's, so a
# patch on the cluster may not outlast its next reconcile.
suspend_automation() {
  local got owner where
  if ! got=$(k -n "$ns" get imageupdateautomation "$1" -o name 2>&1); then
    case "$got" in
      *NotFound*|*"not found"*) echo "  ImageUpdateAutomation $1 is not on this cluster; nothing to suspend."; return 0 ;;
    esac
    echo "  ImageUpdateAutomation $1 could not be read, so it was NOT suspended: $got" >&2
    incomplete="$incomplete $1"; log "NOT suspended $1: unreadable: $got"; return 0
  fi
  if ! k -n "$ns" patch imageupdateautomation "$1" --type merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'; then
    echo "  ImageUpdateAutomation $1 was NOT suspended: the patch failed. It still commits tags to Git." >&2
    incomplete="$incomplete $1"; log "NOT suspended $1: patch failed"; return 0
  fi
  got=$(k -n "$ns" get imageupdateautomation "$1" -o jsonpath='{.spec.suspend}' 2>&1) || got="unreadable ($got)"
  if [ "$got" != true ]; then
    echo "  ImageUpdateAutomation $1 was NOT suspended: spec.suspend reads $got after the patch." >&2
    incomplete="$incomplete $1"; log "NOT suspended $1: spec.suspend=$got"; return 0
  fi
  log "suspended $1"
  owner=$(k -n "$ns" get imageupdateautomation "$1" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.kustomize\.toolkit\.fluxcd\.io/name}' 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$owner" ]; then
    case " $moved " in
      *" $owner "*) where="its ConfigHub unit, which $owner now reads" ;;
      *) where="Git, which $owner still reads" ;;
    esac
    echo "  ImageUpdateAutomation $1 reads suspended now, but Kustomization $owner applies it and will undo this when it next reconciles. To make it last, set spec.suspend: true in $where."
    held="$held $1"
  else
    echo "  Suspended ImageUpdateAutomation $1: spec.suspend reads true."
  fi
}
case "$cluster" in dev-1) suspend_automation 'apptique-dev' ;; esac
echo 'Image automation committed tags to Git, which no longer feeds this cluster. A tag bump is now a change on the base, promoted like any other.'
echo 'Tenant left as it is: team-checkout/team-checkout runs as ServiceAccount team-checkout, reading GitRepository team-checkout; governed as part of tenants. Repointing it would move that team from Git access to ConfigHub access, which is a decision about delegation, not a step in a handover.'
echo 'GitRepository fleet-repo promoted by branch. That is now the workflow'\''s stages: a change is promoted and approved per cluster, not merged between branches.'
echo 'GitRepository team-checkout promoted by branch. That is now the workflow'\''s stages: a change is promoted and approved per cluster, not merged between branches.'

finished=1
echo
echo 'Every layer is Ready from ConfigHub, through the root. To see them:'
echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n $ns get kustomizations -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,SOURCE:.spec.sourceRef.kind,READY:.status.conditions[0].status"
echo 'Nothing was deleted. To go back, in this order: stop the root pruning, restore BOTH fields on each layer as recorded before it moved, then remove the root:'
if [ -n "$owner" ]; then
  echo "  The root is in Git now, so the way back is a revert, with the root's pruning off first:"
  echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch kustomization $owner --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"suspend\":true}}'"
  echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch kustomization confighub-root --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"suspend\":true,\"prune\":false}}'"
  echo "  git revert <the commit above> && git push"
  echo "  kubectl --context '$ctx' -n '$ns' patch kustomization $owner --type merge -p '{\"spec\":{\"suspend\":false}}'   # re-applies the layers from Git, removes the root"
  layer_sources all
else
  way_back all
fi
if [ -n "$held" ]; then
  echo "Suspended on the cluster only, until Git says so too:$held"
fi
if [ -n "$incomplete" ]; then
  echo "HANDOVER INCOMPLETE: every layer moved, but this image automation is still running:$incomplete" >&2
  exit 1
fi
true
